snippet.title: PASTA LA VISTA SUPER MARIO BROS. TRAILER!!
snippet.description:
https://smwc.me/t/132032
the thing I have spent half a year on is finally finished!! 
I hope you guys can enjoy this silly re imagining I whipped up with a few buddies to just show a hint of what you will be receiving in the next installment of this silly fan game franchise I made up!
Video Animated by ME!
Music done by @iamfoogle 
Narrator Voiced by https://x.com/ZaccActs
Wario Voiced by @Shawnster 
Mario Voiced by @CamTheCan
